rows.meaning: where someone or animal was born
rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual Cantonese way to refer to where someone or an animal was born.

example.english: I can't remember where their birthplace is.
example.traditional: 我唔記得佢出世嘅地方喺邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 keoi5 ceot1 sai3 ge3 dei6 fong1 hai2 bin1

rows.meaning: where someone or animal was born
rows.note: A speaker picks this formal term mainly in writing or official contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.jyutping: cing2 tin4 se2 ceot1 saang1 dei6
